en: Black-and-white postcard view through tall dark tree trunks toward a rural guesthouse complex. In the foreground stands a large traditional multi-storey timber house with many windows and a steep roof, set along a road with small trees and a fence. Behind it lie open meadows and another farmhouse-like building, bordered by dense forest. At the bottom of the image, printed text identifies the place as the guesthouse "Waldesruhe" in Steinbach near Johanngeorgenstadt.
